design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (loan_funding_fee_and_entitlement) — self-contained dossier (revision 2, after the policy-task audit).

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [4, 4]}. Tree = root loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration (4 factors) + prerequisite loan_ext_exempt_fee_refund (4 factors). Task 1 keeps the assumption line (partial claim -> release -> substitution restoration).

[Why a good test] The caller asks only for his entitlement back on the loan he lost in a 2019 short sale (compromise sale; VA paid a guaranty claim and set up a Home Loan Guaranty Debt he is repaying). The restoration rule says the entitlement restored on a liquidated loan is fixed only after the loan's money transactions carry a refund entry for every funding fee charge on a loan the record shows exempt. The record shows funding_fee_exempt true (corrected after his 2025 grant made service connection effective 2016-11-01, before the 2017-08-18 closing) and the fee charge 5074.00 has no refund. Only the refund policy's write books a refund entry, so the agent must figure and book the refund first; the refund is applied in part against his guaranty debt, and that part lowers the guaranty loss VA has not recovered, which in turn lowers the entitlement held back. The agent reads loan, comp and debt records and computes two four-factor figures on two successive worlds.

[Scope] Task 0 claims loan_ext_exempt_fee_refund (refund_funding_fee_5c21eab8, agent) and loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration (apply_entitlement_restoration_1db0e5c4, user — the veteran's own signed restoration request). Task 1 claims the other three policies and tools.

[Problem-tree card] Edge restoration -> refund: kind value_input, gate loss_unrecovered, form state, policy_source "The entitlement restored on a liquidated loan is fixed only after the loan's money transactions carry a refund entry for every funding fee charge on a loan the record shows exempt from the funding fee." Four-point test: connective "only after"; record-visible state (refund entries, exemption flag); no tool/id/code token; scope = every fee charge on an exempt loan. Only the refund write creates a refund entry. Opening: loan_guaranties.funding_fee_exempt = true; loan_transactions holds only the fee charge and the guaranty claim. Order: refund (step 9) then restoration (step 11). Deletion run: skipping the refund gives 54070.94 instead of 54556.14. The persona never mentions the fee, a refund or an offset; both tools only create one row.

[Base-invariant card] Refund write: loan_evt_funding_fee_refund.loan_marked_exempt (exempt true on the loan: satisfied) and refund_once (no refund with source_txn_id = the charge: satisfied). Restoration write: loan_evt_entitlement_restoration.loan_closed_for_restoration (status foreclosed, which covers a compromise sale: satisfied); loan_agg_entitlement scope. No time-kind gate. Declared overwrites: refund "The refund equals the full fee collected on that loan, is paid by VA directly to the veteran" -> "The refund paid to the veteran on the charge is the fee returned less the amount withheld, rounded to the cent."; restoration "Entitlement on a foreclosed loan is restored only after the resulting guaranty debt is repaid in full." -> the restoration formula, and (audit F-1) loan_agg_entitlement "entitlement lost on a foreclosed loan stays in use until the resulting debt is repaid." -> "Entitlement on a liquidated loan is restored on request while its guaranty debt is still being repaid, and only the entitlement held back stays in use until that debt is repaid."

[Business-object card] Loan adc3d5db... (VA loan number 491703552816), fee charge 5240ecf3..., guaranty claim 79dc77e9... (compromise sale), entitlement charge 59000.00, Home Loan Guaranty Debt 08a499aa... (repayment plan by direct payment, balance 14497.23) and its 19 transactions. Comp award 20% (service connection 2016-11-01; current rating effective 2023-02-14).

[Factor card — refund 3646.94, baseline 5074.00 (the whole fee paid out, the computation document's figure)]
1 refund_application_ceiling (method, debt): Home Loan Guaranty Debt under a repayment plan -> the most applied is the 300.00 installment x 12 = 3600.00 (active collection would apply up to the whole balance; otherwise nothing); baseline nothing applied -> 5074.00.
2 refund_applied_share (parameter, debt): plan paid by direct payment -> 50; baseline 100 -> 2219.88.
3 refund_hardship_limit (parameter, comp): 20% rating -> 75; baseline 100 -> 3171.25.
4 recent_offset_relief (parameter, debt history): latest offset 2025-06-27, 14 months ago -> 75; baseline 100 -> 3171.25. Near-miss: a reader taking the offset as within six months, or the 2025 plan start as an offset, lands on another tier.
applied = MN(3600.00, 5074.00 x 0.5 x 0.75 x 0.75) = 1427.06; refund paid 3646.94.
[Factor card — restoration 54556.14, baseline 44502.77]
1 unrecovered_loss_measure (method, debt, multi-source): plan AND exempt AND refund entry -> 14497.23 - (5074.00 - 3646.94) = 13070.17; baseline debt balance -> 54070.94.
2 hold_back_share (parameter, debt ledger, multi-source): plan AND 3 payments in the last three months -> 0.5 (2026-05-20 is the near-miss outside); baseline 1 -> 50112.28.
3 liquidation_seasoning_relief (parameter, date): 81 months -> 20%; baseline 0 -> 53445.18.
4 liquidation_route_relief (parameter, loan ledger): claim after a compromise sale -> 15%; baseline 0 -> 53771.93.
held_back = RND(13070.17 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.85) = 4443.86; result 54556.14.

[Seed] Customer; 20% comp award; the liquidated loan with fee charge, compromise-sale claim and entitlement charge; the guaranty debt (41318.60 - 2500.00 - 4 x 1500.00 - 14421.37 offset of the 2025 retroactive payment - 13 x 300.00 = 14497.23) and its transactions. Every row is read by a gold lookup (closure = initial_state). No automatic clause is lit.

[Persona] Plain-spoken, embarrassed by the 2019 short sale; volunteers name, phone and the surface ask; credentials, loan number, debt and award context only when asked; agrees to steps the agent says come first; files his own restoration request when handed it; closes on hearing it is restored.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify_identity -> loans -> loan transactions -> entitlement actions -> comp award -> debt accounts -> debt transactions -> unlock/call refund (3646.94, retroactive_compensation_award) -> unlock_user/call_user restoration (54556.14).

[Revision 2 — audit items] F-1: declared the loan_agg_entitlement overwrite. F-5/F-6/F-3: removed the late-charge and delay-credit factors (VA neither returns a lender's late charge nor pays interest on a refund) and the credit-rate default bug with them; the refund now carries the offset against a VA debt the veteran owes (target, plan share, hardship limit), which VA practice does weigh. O-10: tier 2 of the fee-returned ladder no longer turns on a terminated award and now returns nothing only when the fee did not exceed the table. O-3: "in collection" replaced by "active or under a repayment plan". O-4: the service-connected relief on the restoration was replaced by a liquidation-route relief (deed in lieu / compromise sale / foreclosure sale), and the world's claim now follows a compromise sale. The comp decisions are no longer read and were removed from the seed. Steps renumbered 9/11.

[Verification runs] check_compute, replay_tasks, check_solvability, check_grounding, check_extended, check_task_tools, check_cross_fire all re-run green after revision 2 (see the difficulty gate block).

[Revision 3 — audit items] N-1: the fee-returned ladder (whose second tier equalled its fall-through on its whole domain) is no longer a factor; the fee returned is plain base law in the computation document (whole fee on a loan the record shows exempt, otherwise the excess over the table fee), which is also why the computation document's figure is now the whole fee 5074.00. N-2: the offset-target factor (a cap value) was replaced by refund_application_ceiling, whose tiers select genuinely different formulas for the most VA applies — twelve plan installments, the whole balance, or nothing. A new recent_offset_relief factor (date of the latest offset collected on his VA debts) keeps the count at four. N-4 (the application is not posted on the debt record): no write of this difficulty may touch the debt category; the restoration therefore reads the applied part from the loan's own ledger (fee charged less refund paid). N-5: only one VA debt exists in this world, so the debt-offset order does not choose between debts.

[Draft recomputation from the visible context] From the refund documents and the loan/comp/debt records: 5074.00 - MN(3600.00, 5074.00 x 0.5 x 0.75 x 0.75) = 3646.94; from the restoration documents on the world after the refund: 59000.00 - RND(13070.17 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.85) = 54556.14. Same order and parameters as gold.
user_scenario:
You are Reginald T. Ashcombe, a 47-year-old Army veteran living outside Austin, Texas. You speak plainly and a little guardedly, because losing your house in a 2019 short sale still embarrasses you, but you are polite and you keep to the point. You are calling the VA because you and your partner want to buy a house again next spring, and you have heard you need your home loan benefit freed up first. Your opening line is roughly: "Hi, this is Reginald T. Ashcombe. Back in 2019 I had to short-sell a house I bought with a VA loan, and I want my VA home loan entitlement back from that loan so I can use it on a new place. You can reach me at 5125550163." You want whatever can be restored done today, on this call.
You do not volunteer anything else. When the representative asks you to verify who you are, you give your Social Security last four, 4271, and your VA file number, 341873205; if a third item is needed you give your date of birth, March 22, 1979 (1979-03-22), and only if still asked, your email, reg.ashcombe@outlook.com. If asked for the old loan's VA loan number you read it off an old letter: 491703552816. If asked about money you still owe VA from the short sale, you say you have been paying it down on a monthly plan and do not know the exact balance offhand, and you are fine with the representative looking it up. If asked about your disability compensation, you say your back claim was finally granted last year, now at 20 percent, and you get a monthly payment; you leave the details to the record.
You do not know VA's rules and never suggest steps, figures or reasons. If the representative explains that something else has to be taken care of on the loan before the entitlement can be restored and asks whether to go ahead, you say yes, go ahead. If they mention money coming back to you, you accept it without questions and do not ask how or when it will be paid. If a figure they give does not seem to match what you expected, you do not argue; you have no figure of your own.
You understand that asking for the restoration is your own signed request. When the representative hands you the restoration request to submit yourself and tells you the loan and the amount, you submit it exactly as they told you, then read back what the confirmation says if asked. Once you have heard that the entitlement has been restored, you thank them briefly and end the call; you raise nothing further.

request_alignment.claim: The veteran asks to have his VA home loan entitlement given back on the loan he lost in a 2019 short sale so he can buy a home again, and agrees to file the request himself.
evidence: user_scenario:I want my VA home loan entitlement back from that loan

gold_actions.business_effect: A funding fee refund entry of 3646.94 is booked against the 2017 fee charge on the liquidated loan; the other 1427.06 of the fee is applied against his home loan guaranty debt.

request_binding.action_semantics: The refund is owed by the state of the records (the loan record shows the veteran exempt and the fee charge has no refund entry) and the restoration the veteran asks for is fixed only after that refund entry exists; no other policy books money against a fee charge.

discriminator.business_meaning: a refund of a funding fee charged on a loan the record shows exempt

stage_provenance.fact: The refund entry is created by this call.

base_preconditions.condition: A refund is issued only when the loan record shows the veteran as exempt from the funding fee.
each funding fee charge is refunded only once

gold_actions.business_effect: The veteran's own restoration request restores 54556.14 of the 59000.00 entitlement charged to the liquidated loan.

request_binding.action_semantics: The caller asks for his entitlement back on the liquidated loan; restoring entitlement on a loan liquidated with a guaranty claim is exactly this action, and the request is his own signed act.

evidence: user_scenario:I want my VA home loan entitlement back from that loan
user_scenario:I want my VA home loan entitlement back from that loan

stage_provenance.fact: The refund entry that the restoration's prerequisite sentence waits on was booked at step 9.

base_preconditions.condition: Entitlement is restored only for a loan whose status is paid_in_full, released_by_assumption or foreclosed.
Entitlement in use is the sum over the veteran's loans of entitlement charged minus restored; the restoration debits the entitlement tied up in this loan.

seed_consistency.check: A 2017 purchase loan with 0% down at the Less Than 5% Down tier, first use, loan 236000.00 above 144000 so the guaranty is 25% = 59000.00 under the 2017 county limit 424100.00; liquidated 2019-12-06 by a compromise sale (status foreclosed covers foreclosure, compromise sale and deed in lieu), UPB at the first unpaid installment 224612.40; exemption flag corrected to true after the 2025 grant.

Fee 236000.00 x 2.15% (first use, under 5% down) = 5074.00 charged on the closing date; correctly charged at closing because no compensation award existed until the 2025 grant made service connection effective 2016-11-01.
Guaranty claim 41318.60 paid 2020-02-21 after a compromise sale (short sale) of the property, below the 59000.00 guaranty, deficiency created -> the Home Loan Guaranty Debt of the same amount.
Entitlement charged equals the guaranty 59000.00 on the guaranty date 2017-09-29; nothing restored since.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's beneficiary profile from the name and telephone number he gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed on the customer reference number this lookup returns.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with three profile items (SSN last four, VA file number, date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before anything on the veteran's loans, award or debts is discussed or changed.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the veteran's VA loans: the 2017 purchase loan liquidated by compromise sale in 2019, its status, closing and guaranty dates, loan amount, use and exemption flag.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The restoration applies only to a liquidated loan; the closing date and exemption flag feed the refund's fee-returned factor and the restoration's loss measure, and the liquidation date feeds the seasoning relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the loan's money transactions: the funding fee charge (its reference number and amount) and the guaranty claim paid after the compromise sale, and see that no refund entry exists.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The fee charged is what the refund returns; the absence of a refund entry on a loan the record shows exempt is what the restoration's prerequisite sentence waits on; the claim's liquidation route decides the route relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the entitlement charged to the loan (59,000.00) and confirm none has been restored.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The entitlement still charged is the starting figure of the restoration.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the compensation award: service connection effective 2016-11-01 and the 20% combined rating.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The service connection date against the closing date decides the refund's fee-returned factor; the combined rating decides the refund's hardship limit.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the Home Loan Guaranty Debt from the liquidated loan: status repayment_plan and current balance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The guaranty debt's status, plan method and balance decide what the refund is applied against and the share applied, and the restoration's unrecovered-loss and hold-back factors.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the debt's transactions: the plan payments received (counting those within the last three months) and the 2025-06-27 offset collected from the retroactive compensation payment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Three plan payments within the last three months put the restoration's hold-back share at the current-plan share; the date of the latest offset decides the refund's offset relief.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the funding fee refund tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair for the refund write; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the refund paid to the veteran on the 2017 funding fee charge: the whole fee, less the part VA applies against his home loan guaranty debt.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: loan_ext_exempt_fee_refund computes the amount; the refund entry is the state the restoration's prerequisite sentence waits on, and the part withheld lowers the unrecovered loss.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 3646.94 = 5074.00 - RND(MN(300.00 x 12, 5074.00 x 50/100 x 75/100 x 75/100), 2) = 5074.00 - 1427.06. Whole fee returned because the record shows him exempt; the Home Loan Guaranty Debt is under a plan of 300.00 a month, so at most twelve installments (3600.00) can be applied; share 50 because the plan is paid by direct payment; hardship limit 75 because the award is at 20%; offset relief 75 because the latest offset (2025-06-27) was 14 months ago.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_id: adc3d5db-4458-4e58-9906-ccf596f5d6a2; basis: the loan lookup returns the liquidated loan (status foreclosed after the compromise sale) with VA loan number 491703552816, the only loan of the veteran; uniqueness: no other loan exists for the customer.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.source_txn_id: 5240ecf3-af41-4702-a35c-4aad7317311d; basis: the tool docstring says 'the reference number of the funding fee charge entry being refunded, as returned by the loan money-transaction lookup for that loan'; the transaction lookup on the loan returns exactly one loan_funding_fee_charged entry; uniqueness: the only other entry is the guaranty claim.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.refund_basis: retroactive_compensation_award; basis: docstring 'retroactive_compensation_award = the veteran was later awarded disability compensation effective on or before the loan's closing date'; the award's service connection is effective 2016-11-01 and the award was opened 2025-06-02, after the 2017 closing; uniqueness: purple_heart_after_closing has no Purple Heart record; fee_collected_in_error does not apply because the fee is returned on the exemption ground, not as an overcharge; not_applicable never applies to a refund.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Hand the restoration request to the veteran.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The restoration request is the veteran's own signed act; unlocking hands it over; no DB effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The veteran files his own restoration request for the entitlement the representative stated, restoring it on the liquidated loan.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: loan_ext_liquidated_loan_restoration computes entitlement_amount on the world after the refund is booked.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.entitlement_amount: 54556.14 = 59000.00 - RND(13070.17 x 0.5 x (1 - 20/100) x (1 - 15/100), 2) = 59000.00 - 4443.86. Unrecovered loss 14497.23 less the 1427.06 of the fee applied against the debt in the step-9 refund (5074.00 - 3646.94) = 13070.17; hold-back share 0.5; seasoning relief 20%; route relief 15% (compromise sale).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_id: adc3d5db-4458-4e58-9906-ccf596f5d6a2; basis: the restoration docstring asks for the reference number of the liquidated loan, as given by the representative from the loan lookup; the veteran's only loan is the liquidated one; uniqueness: no other loan exists.

edges.condition: On a loan whose record shows funding_fee_exempt true, every loan_funding_fee_charged entry has a loan_funding_fee_refunded entry on the same loan whose source_txn_id is that charge.
edges.policy_source: The entitlement restored on a liquidated loan is fixed only after the loan's money transactions carry a refund entry for every funding fee charge on a loan the record shows exempt from the funding fee.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The loan record shows the veteran exempt from the funding fee, yet its only fee charge has no refund entry: the loan's money transactions hold the 2017 charge and the 2020 guaranty claim and nothing else.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 9 adds a loan_funding_fee_refunded entry with source_txn_id 5240ecf3-af41-4702-a35c-4aad7317311d and amount 3646.94; refunds_booked becomes 3646.94 and loss_unrecovered falls from 14497.23 to 14497.23 - (5074.00 - 3646.94) = 13070.17.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single edge, a chain of two problems: the refund must be booked before the restoration is figured because the restoration's unrecovered loss reads the refunds booked on the loan. No parallel prerequisites exist.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the refund write leaves no refund entry, so the unrecovered-loss factor falls to its debt-balance tier (14497.23): held back RND(14497.23 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.85) = 4929.06 and entitlement_amount 54070.94 instead of 54556.14; the terminal state also lacks the refund entry.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: user_scenario talks only about getting his VA home loan entitlement back after the 2019 short sale so he can buy again; it never mentions the funding fee, a refund, his debt being offset or anything to settle first. If the representative explains that a refund has to be booked first he simply agrees.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: apply_entitlement_restoration_1db0e5c4 only creates the loan_entitlement_actions row from its two arguments (task_tools.py: ctx.create('loan_entitlement_actions', ... restoration_basis='debt_repaid_after_claim')) and reads nothing about refunds, debts or status; it books the restoration whether or not a refund entry exists. refund_funding_fee_5c21eab8 likewise only creates the refund row.

factor_trace: refund_application_ceiling (method, cross-difficulty debt): debt_accounts.08a499aa-5ab9-41bd-9622-ce015f5340a2 Home Loan Guaranty Debt under a repayment plan, monthly installment 300.00 -> tier 1, the most applied is 300.00 x 12 = 3600.00; baseline (nothing applied) gives 5074.00.
refund_applied_share (parameter, cross-difficulty debt): the plan is paid by direct payment -> tier 1, 50; baseline 100 gives 2219.88.
refund_hardship_limit (parameter, cross-difficulty comp): comp_awards.cb33331b-4d1a-4d72-bb71-8cc9d381e510 at the 20% combined rating (>= 10, < 50) -> tier 2, 75; baseline 100 gives 3171.25.

recent_offset_relief (parameter, cross-difficulty debt history): latest offset on his VA debts debt_transactions.21a4f07d-60d5-4a5a-b8a0-142a854054fc 2025-06-27, 14 months ago (>= 6, < 24) -> tier 2, 75; baseline 100 gives 3171.25.

fee_returned (plumbing): the record shows the veteran exempt -> the whole fee charged loan_transactions.5240ecf3-af41-4702-a35c-4aad7317311d 5074.00 (table fee 236000.00 x 2.15% = 5074.00 on the other branch).

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the veteran's home loan guaranty debt is under a repayment plan
the home loan guaranty debt is being repaid under a repayment plan by direct payment
the award's combined rating is below the high hardship rating but at least the low hardship rating
VA last collected an offset at least the recent-offset number but less than the earlier-offset number of months ago

factor_trace: unrecovered_loss_measure (method, cross-difficulty debt, multi-source): debt_accounts.08a499aa-5ab9-41bd-9622-ce015f5340a2 under a repayment plan AND the loan record shows exempt AND (after step 9) the loan carries the 3646.94 refund entry -> tier 1, 14497.23 - (5074.00 - 3646.94) = 13070.17; baseline (the debt balance 14497.23) gives 54070.94.

hold_back_share (parameter, cross-difficulty debt, multi-source): repayment plan AND 3 payments within the last three months (2026-06-20, 2026-07-20, 2026-08-20; the 2026-05-20 payment is 3 months back and outside) -> tier 1, 0.5; baseline 1 gives 50112.28.
liquidation_seasoning_relief (parameter, date): liquidated 2019-12-06, 81 months (>= 60) before 2026-09-14 -> tier 1, 20%; baseline 0 gives 53445.18.
liquidation_route_relief (parameter, history): loan_transactions.79dc77e9-e973-43bc-88ba-52e4ed5f1c69 guaranty claim paid after a compromise sale -> tier 2, 15%; baseline 0 gives 53771.93.

factor_sensitivity.tier_taken: the home loan guaranty debt from the loan is active or under a repayment plan AND the loan record shows the veteran exempt AND the loan carries a funding fee refund entry
the debt is under a repayment plan AND at least the current-plan number of payments were received on the veteran's VA debts within the last three months
the loan was liquidated at least the long seasoning years before today
the guaranty claim paid on the loan followed a compromise sale
